ability.powers.starfall.active.1: Your first convergence has not yet closed its celestial ledger.
ability.powers.starfall.active.2: Only one star-crown may answer your name at a time.
ability.powers.starfall.active.3: The existing astrolabe refuses to overlap its own unfinished verdict.

ability.powers.starfall.blocked.2: No lawful constellation can be anchored at that protected point.
ability.powers.starfall.blocked.3: The heavens find no loaded, unsealed place beneath your gaze.
ability.powers.starfall.blocked.4: A counter-sigil closes the astrolabe before its first omen.

ability.powers.starfall.interrupted.2: Amethyst, time or distance tears your storm from the sky.
ability.powers.starfall.interrupted.3: The unfinished celestial ledger closes without a crown.

ability.powers.starfall.complete.3: The Astral Convergence returns its crown to the silent heavens.
ability.powers.fireball.blocked.1: No complete flame-heart can open inside this stone.
ability.powers.fireball.blocked.2: The summoning volume is sealed; the offered fire returns to you.
ability.powers.fireball.blocked.3: Every forward ember-cell is obstructed, so no heart is born.
ability.powers.fireball.sealed.1: That Cinderheart has already accepted every seal your rank can hold.
ability.powers.fireball.sealed.2: A launched heart cannot be charged from behind its own wake.
ability.powers.fireball.sealed.3: The existing flame refuses another name until its verdict ends.
ability.powers.lightning_strike.active.1: Your first storm compass has not yet closed its verdict.
ability.powers.lightning_strike.active.2: Only one tribunal may answer your storm-signature at a time.
ability.powers.lightning_strike.active.3: The unfinished thunder rite refuses to overlap itself.
No loaded lawful sky-column answers beneath that mark.
Amethyst, sanctuary, Darkness or a protected boundary grounds the charge.

The sky withdraws its verdict and leaves no hostile weather behind.
ability.powers.lightning_strike.complete: The last electric glyph fades, and the old thunder closes its ledger.

ability.powers.speed_burst.second_step.1: The first stride leaves a door of lightning behind you. Step through it once more.
ability.powers.speed_burst.second_step.2: Two kinetic sigils align. Motion remembers one final path.
ability.powers.speed_burst.second_step.3: The wake has not closed. Release the Second Step before its echo fades.
ability.powers.telekinesis.empty.1: Your will reaches outward, but finds nothing it is permitted to seize.
ability.powers.telekinesis.empty.2: The violet circle collapses unanswered. No movable mind or missile lies within it.
ability.powers.telekinesis.empty.3: The unseen hand closes on empty air; its offered energy returns to you.
ability.powers.control.resisted: %s bends, but the target's will cuts the force to a fraction.

screen.powers.locator.title: Celestial Locator
screen.powers.locator.empty: No other soul answers the stars.
grimoire.celestial.offline.1: The heavens find no soul with that name. The search unravels.
grimoire.celestial.offline.2: The trail goes cold — they left the world before the stars could answer.
grimoire.celestial.offline.3: Starlight returns empty. The target slipped beyond reach.
grimoire.celestial.amethyst.1: The amethyst you carry screams — the celestial words recoil into your skull.
grimoire.celestial.amethyst.2: Purple static swallows the spell. The amethyst's curse turns your vision to chaos.
grimoire.celestial.amethyst.3: The grimoire shrieks as the amethyst curse grounds its power. Nausea wracks you.
grimoire.celestial.light_gate.1: The Light Realm blinds your eyes — only an Origin may scry its halls.
grimoire.celestial.light_gate.2: A curtain of pure light blocks your sight. The Light Realm accepts only its masters.
grimoire.celestial.light_gate.3: The Light Realm's radiance washes the spell away. Reach the top of the light path before peering inside.
grimoire.celestial.dark_gate.1: The Dark Realm's shadows drink your spell. Only Nightfall may gaze into that blackness.
grimoire.celestial.dark_gate.2: Void-fingers catch your sight and crush it. The Dark Realm keeps its secrets from the unmarked.
grimoire.celestial.dark_gate.3: The grimoire's pages blacken — the Dark Realm rejects your stare. Master the darkness first.
grimoire.celestial.reveal.1: The heavens part. The stars whisper %s's location to you alone.
grimoire.celestial.reveal.2: Starlight threads the void and returns bearing %s's secret.
grimoire.celestial.reveal.3: The celestial script burns the answer into your mind: %s.
grimoire.celestial.true_sight.1: Your opened inner eye pierces the mindscape veil. No realm can hide the chosen soul.
grimoire.celestial.true_sight.2: True Sight burns cyan-gold across your vision; the veil parts without yielding its other secrets.
grimoire.celestial.true_sight.3: The stars name this impossible seeing: True Sight. Light and darkness alike become transparent.

ability.powers.anchored_teleport_blocked: You are dimensionally anchored — teleport blocked!

The void whispers your name and denies you entry.

The dark realm's gate tastes your soul and finds you unworthy.
ability.powers.no_entry.2: The world's edge turns you away — entry denied.
ability.powers.no_entry.3: An unseen barrier bars this path.
ability.powers.no_entry.4: Something beyond the veil refuses your presence here.
ability.powers.marking_mode.1: Spectator mode — fly to your desired spot and press the power key to mark it.
ability.powers.marking_mode.2: You ascend as a spirit! Mark your landing spot with the power key.
ability.powers.marking_mode.3: Watch from afar, ghost! Choose your destination and press the power key.
ability.powers.marking_expired.2: Your ghostly search lasted too long — the mark fades and you return.
ability.powers.marking_expired.3: The window closes; your mark is lost.

energy.powers.empty.2: The well inside you has run dry. Rest, and let it refill.

energy.powers.backlash.5: Your recklessness has drawn the gods' ire! A storm of punishment breaks over you.

crystal.powers.unavailable.4: This crystal holds no answer for you at this moment.

ability.powers.astral_started.2: Your spirit leaves its shell! Call it back with the power key.

ability.powers.astral_ended.2: Your astral form dissolves as you reunite with your body.
ability.powers.astral_ended.3: The projection fades — you are whole once more.

amethyst.powers.suppressed.5: The crystal ward flares! Your power shatters against its unyielding light.
amethyst.powers.suppressed.6: Amethyst venom courses through you as it crushes your attempted power.

amethyst.powers.target_protected.4: Amethyst light flares around your target, deflecting your power.

amethyst.powers.teleport_repelled.2: The ward's light blazes — your teleport is hurled back in a shattering clash!
amethyst.powers.teleport_repelled.3: The Amethyst Ward denies you! Its power burns as it casts you out.
amethyst.powers.teleport_repelled.4: You strike the ward's barrier — purple lightning rends your teleport apart.
amethyst.powers.teleport_repelled.5: The amethyst's fury meets you mid-journey, flinging you back in agony!

rune.powers.channelled.2: %s energy floods from the carved stone.

rune.powers.channelled.4: A pulse of %s raw energy passes into you.

rune.powers.full.4: Your pool brims; the rune's power is wasted.

skill.powers.advanced.2: A surge of might flows through you as you become %s.

realm.powers.return_restricted: The realm refuses to release your spirit. Reach rank 5, or await administrative recovery.

realm.powers.light_memory_1: A first memory: light was not born gentle. It learned mercy only after it learned to burn.
realm.powers.light_memory_2: A faceless guardian remembers every life it could save, and the one it could not.
realm.powers.light_memory_3: The stars answer questions with distance. Wisdom is deciding which silence is an answer.
realm.powers.light_memory_4: A golden sigil closes around an ancient wound in the world. Something still knocks from the other side.
realm.powers.light_memory_5: You remember walking between seconds, though these feet have never taken that road.
realm.powers.light_memory_6: A chorus without mouths speaks your name as if it belonged to someone far older.
realm.powers.dark_memory_1: The first shadow was cast by the first light—and has hated its maker ever since.
realm.powers.dark_memory_2: A memory hides from you. The shape of its absence looks exactly like your face.
realm.powers.dark_memory_3: Something below thought repeats your oldest secret in a voice you have not used yet.
realm.powers.dark_memory_4: Six broken names hang from an iron word. Speaking the seventh would make the chain yours.
realm.powers.dark_memory_5: Night remembers the sun. It simply chooses not to forgive it.
realm.powers.dark_memory_6: The hollow is not empty. It is listening with perfect patience.
realm.powers.light_complete: All six radiant memories align. The mindscape recognizes you as a keeper of its unfinished dawn.
realm.powers.dark_complete: All six hollow memories awaken. The darkness now knows which name to whisper when you sleep.
realm.powers.dark_eclipse.1: A Dark Eclipse closes over the mindscape. Darkness swells; every unclaimed thought begins to drown.
realm.powers.whiteout.1: Whiteout descends. Pure Light stops pretending to be gentle and burns every shadow from the mind.
realm.powers.event_clear: The force storm recedes, but its pressure remains in the distance.
force.powers.dark_invasion.1: The Eclipse Scar opens. The Hollowed are coming.
force.powers.light_invasion.1: A Dawn Scar ignites. A Radiant Sentinel has judged you.
